name: Greedy v1
description: The built-in bot every opponent used until 2026-11-23: scores each legal action with a hand-written heuristic (capture > promote > kill > grow cities > research > train > move toward the nearest hamlet, ruin, enemy or fog) and ends its turn when nothing scores above 0. Weights = DEFAULT_WEIGHTS in logic/engine/bot.ts; the exact source at snapshot time is policy.snapshot.ts.
